title: Support linked worktrees in Git operations and hooks
body:
## Summary

- Ignore inherited Git directory variables when running repository commands.
- Resolve shared Git directories for linked worktrees and LFS objects.
- Install hooks through `core.hooksPath` so each worktree uses its tracked hooks.
- Add linked-worktree and hook behavior tests.
- Pin package and skill references to version 0.5.2.

## Testing

- Added tests for Git commands with inherited `GIT_DIR` and `GIT_WORK_TREE`.
- Added tests for linked-worktree indexing, repository naming, and Git LFS reads.
- Added tests that verify hooks run from the active worktree.
- Not run
